answer: To join, a name must pass Ashbound bisque firer plate charter, which works because a charter bisque firers sign after throwing room audits. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: a toll of 38 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down is the price, and the river never covers it twice. The hollow is checked, not assumed. Every summit is counted once.
